label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

colors.description: Every fill colour used, most used first.

files.description: Links to any extra formats asked for: png, pdf, eps, dxf, icons (zip), small (simplified SVG).

score.description: How close the SVG is to the source picture: fidelity (0-1, higher is better), edge (colour error on edges, lower is better), holes and spill (per mille, lower is better).

svg.description: The SVG document. Only <g> groups and filled <path>s: no scripts, no embedded bitmap.

url.description: A public link to the same SVG.

width.description: Display width in pixels. The picture's own shape is kept.

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
